profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer
profile.summary: Adrian Parker has both professional and personal experience in an array of languages and platforms, anything and everything that serves up data on Layer 7 technologies. Be it microservices speaking gRPC or React web clients, he maximizes his potential to glue user-facing interfaces together with back-end technologies.
